input.title: Give the newsletter email input an accessible name that matches its visible label
input.rationale: The input #news-email has no accessible name. A visible <label>Email address</label> sits right before it (about.html line 11), but the label has no for attribute and doesn't wrap the input, so the two aren't linked. I can only edit the element at offset 381, so this patch adds aria-label="Email address" to the input. The text matches the visible label exactly, so speech-input users can say the same words they see. A better fix for a developer to make in source: add for="news-email" to the <label> on line 11 and drop this aria-label. That also lets users click the label text to focus the field. Adding autocomplete="email" to the input would help too. Please check this with a screen reader before treating the issue as resolved.
